heading_path: Division 2—Proceedings before the Registrar or a court
text: (1) The Registrar may award costs in respect of the matters, and in the amounts, provided for in the regulations against any party to proceedings brought before him or her. (2) A party desiring to obtain costs must apply to the Registrar in accordance with the regulations. (3) If a party is ordered to pay the costs of another party, the costs may be recovered in a court of competent jurisdiction as a debt due by the first party to the other party.
